role: Prepare measured PET/MRI images for independent review; not a registration accuracy benchmark
cohort: All 20 scans, baseline MRI from same subject
PET_summary: Duration-weighted mean of frames starting at >=20 min
geometry: Original NIfTI physical coordinates converted RAS to LPS; 4mm reduced images; frozen 0.3.0rc1 multimodal rigid registration
output: Every automatic transform, resampled PET mean, MRI, overlays, failures
truth: No independent reference is available; never use the automatic transform as ground truth
pending: An expert must annotate identifiable paired landmarks independently of these overlays; tolerance must be reviewed and locked before landmark errors are calculated
REG-02: Remains blocked until at least 10 independently referenced measured pairs and reviewed tolerance exist
